description: REQUIRES prior wetax__session__login call with same account_link_id. 기관에 저장합니다. 소득자별 명세 줄을 검사한 뒤 저장합니다. 명세는 선택이라 줄 없이 보내면 명세 없이 다음 단계로 넘어갑니다. 소득 종류, 성명, 식별번호가 같은 줄이 둘이면 거절합니다.

account_link_id.description: Account link ID (UUID v4). Optional — the server auto-resolves from your API key when omitted. Provide explicitly only when you have multiple certificates for the same provider. Each institution has a separate ID (Hometax != NHIS != NPS != FourInsure).

dclr_id.description: Draft filing ID returned by the declarant step.

statement_rows.description: One row per payee: income_type_code, payment_date, payee_name, payee_identifier, tax_base_amount, calculated_tax_amount, adjustment_amount, payment_amount.
